scope.coverage: Read-only React adapter and S1-S6 composition review; targeted focus/session/hover/Escape/splitter/storage ownership inspection plus existing focused tests. This is not full accessibility, all N01-N38, human visual approval, or an independent review of the pure core/R4-R6.

findings.title: Selected Ribbon tab cannot open temporary tools
reproduction: Click 收起工具区 to enter tabs-only mode
Click the already-selected 开始 tab
findings.expected: Any visible tool tab activation including the currently selected group opens temporary tools, retaining the tabs owner height.
findings.cause: OPEN_RIBBON_TEMP is dispatched only from onValueChange; selecting the same tab does not change its value.
findings.recommendation: Handle activation of the current tab in the local Ribbon intent entry, retaining the existing Tabs semantics and defaults.
findings.gateImpact: Fix targeted S5 behavior before accepting this batch; no change to other workspaces required.

findings.title: S5 focus retains the document header
findings.expected: Approved reference focus mode hides .workspace-head; the stable external identity/recovery bar remains.
findings.referenceEvidence: approved-v0.4.2.html selector .prototype[data-vr-focus=true] .workspace-head {display:none!important}; S5 source uses that header class.
findings.recommendation: Add an S5-local focused header rule; retain mounted document data and original layout restore.
findings.gateImpact: Fix and recapture affected S5 focus state before visual acceptance.

findings.title: S4 grading recovery bar displays the interaction identity
findings.actual: The toolbar always uses sceneTitles[S4] 辩论赛：大学校园是否应该免费开放 and sceneSubtitles[S4] 课堂互动 / 小组讨论, independent of grading variant and current business object.
findings.expected: The external workspace identity matches the grading scene and selected student/question.
findings.referenceEvidence: evidence/runtime/navigation-v042/w4/reference/2026-10-01T11-55-02-325Z/S4-grading-1440-pass1.fragment.html: A 卷 · 第一题 · 概念辨析 · 李梦 / 按题批改 · 仅本地演示草稿.
findings.recommendation: Expose or reuse the recipe-owned live business identity in the S toolbar instead of scene constants; keep recovery controls on the stable external owner.
findings.gateImpact: Incorrect visible current-workspace identity should be corrected before S4 grading acceptance.

findings.title: Disabling hover leaves a scheduled open timer active
reproduction: Mount WorkspaceLayout hoverPreview=true with a hidden directory region and intent=peek restore trigger
Fire pointerEnter on its trigger, scheduling the 240ms hover-open timeout
Rerender the same workspace with hoverPreview=false before the delay
findings.expected: Once hover enhancement is disabled, a previously scheduled hover-open intent cannot open a panel.
findings.cause: The hoverPreview dependency only changes the handler callback; no effect clears the scheduled timer and its callback does not recheck the current flag.
findings.verification: Read-only in-memory Rolldown bundle with React/testing-library/jsdom, no implementation/test files written; observed exact actual payload above.
findings.recommendation: Cancel timers when hoverPreview becomes false, or guard delayed callbacks against the current flag; add a prop-toggle timer regression.
findings.gateImpact: Correct this adapter lifecycle edge before accepting optional hover behavior.

observations: No additional P1 was found within this scoped adapter review.

Existing tests cover focus layout/session restoration, one-layer Escape for a child popup, hover timer cleanup across workspace keys/StrictMode, outside first-click/focus behavior, mounted region draft+scroll retention, end-side splitter physical keyboard direction, denied storage, effective width derivation, and S5 per-instance drafts/restore IDs.
Storage format validation and reducers remain outside independent scope because the reviewer authored the pure core.

closure.scope: Read-only closure of ADAPTER-01..04. Actual S5/S3/S4 toolbar and document-header browser behavior; WorkspaceLayout hover disable lifecycle via in-memory React test. This does not independently review the reviewer-authored pure core or R4-R6 business implementation, full accessibility, N01-N38, or a Human Gate.
